polarity_reports.heldout_policy: All comb seeds, membership and fit parameters use training only. Heldout residuals use frozen training tooth indices.
polarity_reports.warning: A free-offset comb spacing is not necessarily a clock fundamental. Subharmonic aliases and common periodic clutter remain.

frequency_calibration: No receiver LO/clock accuracy or absolute RF uncertainty supplied.
inference: Exploratory RF structure only. No MIPI, lane-count or byte-clock identification.

time_scale_references.provenance: Previously observed reconstruction periods; not authenticated DSI packet/panel timing.
time_scale_references.frame_sideband_warning: Default block spans about two frames; Hann cannot cleanly resolve adjacent frame-rate sidebands.

hypothesis.label: Declared conditional seed, not measured. 750*1334*60 for N=3 and payload duty1.

notes: Local flank-median excess is not MATLAB topographic prominence and not SNR.
Peak error floors are resolution/drift diagnostics, not calibrated absolute RF confidence intervals.
Formal comb fit standard errors condition on selected tooth assignments; model-search uncertainty is not included.
No subtraction, resampling, coherent averaging, demodulation or raw modification was performed.
